responseText:
I can’t change folder permissions or monitor for “legal clearance” in the background from here. I can, however, prepare exactly what you need so the change happens safely and with minimal follow-up. Which of these would you like me to do now?

- A — Draft a one-click/one-step instruction (or script) your IT/admin can run to set the folder to company-wide read access.
- B — Draft an email/request for Legal + IT to confirm clearance and then have IT apply the change (I can include wording and the exact folder & permission details).
- C — Draft an automation workflow (e.g., Power Automate, Zapier, or a Google Apps Script) that applies the permission change when Legal signals clearance — note I can only prepare the workflow; I cannot deploy or run it without access to your systems.
- D — Give step‑by‑step manual instructions you (or someone on your team) can follow right now.

I’ll prepare the chosen deliverable, but first I need a few details:

1. Platform: Google Drive, OneDrive/SharePoint, Box, or other?  
2. Exact folder location (shared drive name and folder path, or link).  
3. Permission scope: “company-wide read access” = everyone@yourcompany domain as Viewer? Any exceptions (exclude contractors, certain groups)?  
4. Apply recursively to all subfolders/files? (yes/no)  
5. Notification: should users be notified when the permission changes? Should Legal or a specific owner receive confirmation once applied?  
6. How will Legal signal clearance? (e.g., they’ll send an email to you/IT, add a tag to a doc, mark a checklist item) — if you want an automation, tell me the trigger.  
7. Any compliance/retention concerns or sensitive files in the folder that must be excluded?

Tell me which option (A–D) you want and answer the questions above, and I’ll prepare the exact text, commands, or automation template ready for handoff.
